dependencies.name: oorexx_socket_provider
dependencies.purpose: current protocol-independent SocketSelector baseline from Library reconciliation; XTP remains isolated behind this boundary

dependencies.name: oorexx
dependencies.purpose: native ooRexx SocketSelector/XTP qualification runtime supplied from Library

dependencies.name: libcrypto
dependencies.purpose: dev32 per-service protection: HKDF-SHA256, AES-256-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305, RAND_bytes; the same libcrypto oorexx_crypto_v0.8.3 binds through Foreign Runtime

dependencies.name: oorexx_ldap_identity
dependencies.purpose: rexx/XtpLdapKeySource.cls reads XTP key sets from the Identity Directory over LDAP (LdapWireClient)

dependencies.name: oorexx_secret_broker
dependencies.purpose: resolves key generation secret references; key material never travels over LDAP

operational_degradation_planner.required_for: registered-class degradation planning, per-context cap and XTP enforcement adapter; the Makefile default OPERATIONAL_PLANNER_DIR

vendored: none: vendor/socket_provider holds only a README pointing at the dev16 authority
